subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined phrase in the given sentence.

Despite the failure, the startup managed to __keep their heads above water.__
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **avoid trouble**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The phrase **"keep their heads above water"** is an idiom that means to survive or manage to cope with a difficult situation, especially financial difficulties. (मुश्किल परिस्थितियों में जीवित रहना या संभलना) • **Example:** Even with rising costs, the small business managed to keep its head above water. • **"Avoid trouble" **refers to staying out of problems or difficult situations. (मुसीबत से बचना) • **Example:** He avoided trouble by carefully following all the rules. • Hence, the most appropriate substitution for the underlined phrase is **"avoid trouble"**. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 2: Give up** (हार मान लेना): To stop trying or to accept defeat. • **Example:** He decided not to give up and kept working hard toward his goal. • **Option 3: Fail miserably** (पूरी तरह से असफल होना): To fail in a significant or complete manner. • **Example:** The project failed miserably due to poor planning. • **Option 4: Succeed completely** (पूरी तरह से सफल होना): To achieve total success without any failures. • **Example:** The team succeeded completely in delivering the project on time. 3a:Tc5f, The correct answer is: **Option 4 (Welcome)**.
